prompt: A painted map of a whole continent seen from directly above, no perspective, in the manner of a 19th-century academic oil painting with a smooth, finely blended surface: soft glazed transitions, fine detail, minimal visible brushstrokes, no heavy impasto. Palette of umber, ochre, olive, dull gold, near-black green and deep grey-blue. The whole square is land and sea with no border, no text, no labels, no compass, no legend. Geography, filling the square. Sea on three sides: a narrow cold grey sea down the whole left edge; it widens in the lower left corner into a pale, shallow, misty bay; the sea continues as a strip along the whole bottom edge, widens in the lower right corner and runs up the right edge to a little past halfway, above which the land reaches the right edge. The top edge is all land. Along the top, from the upper left across to the upper right, a great wall of snow-capped grey mountains, highest in the top center, with one bare grey peak standing slightly apart at its right end. In the upper left, below the mountains, brown upland moor and broken hills with long valleys, and a small pale salt basin where the moor meets the mountains. In the upper right, a very large dense dark conifer forest reaching the top and right edges; below it, a wide pale gold grass steppe running to the right edge, with one small white-rimmed salt lake on it. In the exact center of the square, a broad ring of old worn olive hills enclosing one large, dark, still, round lake with no river leaving it; a river runs straight down from the top center mountains into this lake. Left of the central hills, a broadleaf forest; further left and lower, rust-colored broken hills cut by a gorge, from which a river runs left across a stony plain to the left sea. In the lower left, a slow brown river winding from the central hills down into a wide reed marsh and the misty bay. In the bottom center, a wide flat dark-earth farm plain with a river running straight down through it from the central hills to the bottom sea, and one small lone hill on the plain. In the lower right, gentle hills on both sides of a river that runs to a marshy delta of many mouths on the lower right coast, and a long pale beach coast. In the right center, low rounded folded hills around a river running right to the right sea. Soft shadows showing relief, light from the upper left. Rich, moody, quiet. No clouds, no fog bank hiding the land, no figures, no buildings, no roads, no writing of any kind.
